pages.title: Fishing the Russian Way
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fishing the Russian Way takes you to rivers and lakes across central Russia. Work the rod to bring in different fish, then decide what to do with your catch. Improve your tackle and drive to new fishing spots as they become available. Take on tasks or tournaments and look for rare finds to add to your collection.

pages.title: Sea Lords
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sea Lords starts with a small fishing port and a shipping business to grow. Buy ships, improve their speed and cargo capacity, and open up new routes. Upgrade docks and hire captains to automate deliveries. The port can keep earning while you are away, giving you more to invest when you return.

pages.title: Toca Teens Floating Beach Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Toca Teens Floating Beach Party is a dress-up game about getting a group ready for a summer party on the water. Pick a warm-weather outfit for each teen and try different combinations before the party begins. Give everyone a style of their own while choosing clothes that suit the same beach setting.

pages.title: Idle Barber Shop
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Idle Barber Shop puts you in charge of a salon. Hire barbers to serve customers, upgrade their stations and build up the income from each round of haircuts. Decide where to spend the shop's profits as business grows. Another barber or a better station can help you handle more customers.

pages.title: 10K
pages.creator: Jogo | playgen.io
pages.description: 10K is a geography game that asks you to locate five cities on a blank map. Start with 10,000 points and place a marker for each guess. The farther your marker is from the actual city, the more points you lose. Pan and zoom when you need to place a marker more precisely.

pages.title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire asks you to clear a layout by taking cards one rank higher or lower than the active card. Look for a sequence before taking the first card so you can keep the run going. As the locations and layouts change, work out which cards to uncover first.

pages.title: Mahjong Magic Islands
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Mahjong Magic Islands is a tile-matching adventure set in a world of mythical creatures. Find matching tiles that are free to remove, then use the space they leave to uncover more pairs. Solving the boards takes you through ancient island cities as you help restore their magic and natural beauty.

pages.title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
pages.creator: PoRfe
pages.description: Traffic Light Simulator 3D puts you in charge of the signals at a city intersection. Decide when to let each stream of cars through and when to make it wait. Keep the crossing clear while preventing queues from growing too long. Later levels give you more traffic to handle at once.

pages.title: Face Changes
pages.creator: Dmytro Kodrul
pages.description: Face Changes is a puzzle about assembling faces. Look at the face you need to recreate and put the features together in the right arrangement. Complete a face to advance to the next level. You can also use training mode to practice recognizing the combinations and try to improve your result.

pages.title: Ice Cream Roller!
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Ice Cream Roller! is a runner where you build an ice cream ball on the way to a waiting child. Gather ice cream to make the ball larger and pick up fruit to add to it. Dodge obstacles that can knock away part of the ball. Try to reach the finish with a big serving and plenty of fruit.

pages.title: Strike It!
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Strike It! is a physics puzzle that trades bowling pins for groups of little figures. Aim the ball and release it, then watch it bounce and knock figures down. Pick an angle that can reach several targets in one shot. Earn coins from strikes and put them toward new balls.

pages.title: Traffic Rider Moto Bike Racing
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Traffic Rider Moto Bike Racing takes a sport bike onto a busy highway. Watch the vehicles around you and look for openings to pass slower traffic. Move into a gap only when you have room to get through it. Build up speed where the road is clear and dodge cars as the traffic closes in.

pages.title: 11x11 BLOXX
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: 11x11 BLOXX gives you an eleven-by-eleven grid and blocks in different shapes. Place the pieces to complete entire rows or columns and clear them for coins and points. Look at the shape of the empty spaces before placing a block. A full line makes room for more pieces as the board fills.

pages.title: Stickman vs Skibidi Toilet
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman vs Skibidi Toilet is a survival fighting game where a stickman takes on enemies from Skibidi Toilet. Move and jump with the arrow keys or WASD. Press C to defend and E to use a special move. Watch the enemies as you decide whether to block, move away or fight back.

pages.title: Skibidi Survival Challenge
pages.creator: goolgames
pages.description: Skibidi Survival Challenge puts Skibidi Toilet into a competition inspired by Squid Game. Watch the cues for each task and react in time to stay in the running. The challenges test when to move and when to wait. Survive the tasks as they change and try to reach the end of the competition.

pages.title: Squid escape
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description: Squid escape is a runner set inside a dangerous competition. Steer your participant through the obstacles and pick up coins along the way. Look ahead before changing direction so you can get to the pickups without running into a hazard. Survive each stretch and keep going toward the escape.

pages.title: Block Blast
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Block Blast gives you an eight-by-eight grid and a set of blocks to place. Drag the shapes onto the board to finish rows or columns and clear space. You have to work with each shape in the orientation it comes in. The round ends when none of the remaining blocks can fit.

pages.title: Aqua Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Aqua Link is a timed matching puzzle where identical blocks must be joined by a path with at most two turns. Look for open routes around the other blocks and remove pairs to make more space. Keep checking for connections that were blocked earlier. Clear the whole board before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Bowling Challenge
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Bowling Challenge is a sports game where you aim a ball down the lane to knock over the pins. Adjust your aim if a roll leaves pins standing, and try to clear as many as possible with each attempt. Work your way up against other bowlers as you compete for the national championship trophy.

pages.title: Santa games
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Santa games sends you through seven levels to collect gifts and find the magic sleigh. Look for magic letters along the way too. They open seven extra minigames, including Diamond Rain, Drop Gift and Brick Out. Follow the main route first or gather letters to try more of the holiday challenges.

pages.title: Cookie Crush Christmas 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Cookie Crush Christmas 2 is a match-three puzzle set in a Christmas landscape. Make matches with cookies, cakes and doughnuts as you work through the level objectives. The journey has more than 3,000 levels, with coin chests to discover along the way. Check which treats each board needs before using your moves.

pages.title: Metal Army War Revenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Metal Army War Revenge sends its heroes into the jungle to stop a robot invasion. Fight through new enemies, destroy traps and free hostages as you advance. Pick up metallic materials along the way and visit the Market after levels. Use the materials to upgrade your weapons and increase your health for the next mission.

pages.title: Neon Pong Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Neon Pong Multi player lets you enter a lobby to play paddle tennis against another player. Move your paddle with the arrow keys or touch the sides of the screen. Return the ball and try to send it past your opponent. The first player to score seven points wins the match.

pages.title: Timberman
pages.creator: Digital Melody S.A.
pages.description: Timberman is an arcade game about chopping a tree without getting hit by its branches. Switch sides as the branches come down and keep the axe moving. Work toward a higher score on the leaderboard or unlock new lumberjacks as you play. The updated game also gives you a village to expand.

pages.title: Besties Summer Vacation
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Besties Summer Vacation follows friends getting ready for a beach trip in an old van. Choose makeup and outfits for the travelers, then turn to the van and decorate it for the outing. Try different colors and styles across the two parts of the game, from the clothes to the vehicle.

pages.title: Rope Man Rush 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Rope Man Rush 3D is a runner about guiding a figure made from colored rope. Collect ropes that match your runner's current color and steer around obstacles. Check the path before moving across it so you can reach matching pickups safely. Get the rope figure to the circular platform at the end.

pages.title: Squid impostor Golden Key
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Squid impostor Golden Key is a platform adventure where the key only appears after you defeat the enemies. Get into position to crush each opponent while keeping your character safe. Once the last one is gone, find the golden key and pick it up to finish the level and continue.

pages.title: Tales of Crevan
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Tales of Crevan follows a fox through the hand-drawn worlds inside an artist's magical paintings. Guide Crevan around obstacles and collect paint to bring color back to the scenery. Pick up colored fox tails to restore health and decide when to fight or avoid monsters. Finding a spider opens a bonus mission.

pages.title: Brawl Warfire Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Brawl Warfire Online puts a group of Western heroes against an army of invading robots. Use the on-screen buttons to direct the fight as the machines close in. Keep the heroes in action and work through the opposing forces. The aim is to stop the robots before they can take over the towns.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Hello Spring
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Objects Hello Spring gives you sixteen spring scenes to search against the clock. Check the list on the left and find each object among the flowers, greenery and animals. Use the magnifying glass to zoom in and drag the scene to inspect another area. A hint can help when an object is hard to spot.

pages.title: Dust Buster.io
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Dust Buster.io turns cleaning into a contest between vacuum cleaners. Drag to steer and suck up objects to grow. Once you are large enough, you can swallow smaller cleaners too, so watch out for bigger ones. Gather as much as you can before time runs out, online against other players or in offline mode.

pages.title: Tank Off
pages.creator: Martian Games
pages.description: Tank Off is a multiplayer capture-the-flag game with tanks powered by alien technology. Use Space to jump and Shift for turbo, and take advantage of a tank that can travel through water. Choose from four maps and unlock four tanks. Upgrade attributes such as cannon damage or reload speed to suit how you fight.

pages.title: Adam and Eve Go 3
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Adam and Eve Go 3 sends Adam through fifteen prehistoric levels to bring a rose to Eve. Move with the arrow keys and climb ladders with Up and Down. Watch for dinosaurs and traps, and use pressure plates or other objects to open blocked routes. Pick up the rose before heading to Eve.

pages.title: Save The Fish
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Save The Fish is a rescue puzzle about getting a trapped fish back to the ocean. Look over each mechanism before making a move, and find a route through the sewers that keeps the fish clear of traps and sharks. Later levels leave it trapped deeper inside, so pay attention to what each move opens up.

pages.title: Football Heads
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Football Heads is an arcade football game where you face an opponent and try to get the ball past them. Use different kicks to attack and pick up power-ups that change the play. Watch the ball on the way back toward your goal. Use the emotes when you want to react during the match.

pages.title: Jelly Challenge
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Jelly Challenge is a match-three game with colorful jelly pieces. Drag a jelly with the mouse or your finger to bring matching pieces together. Look for groups that can set up another match once the board changes. Keep collecting jellies and see how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Racing Motorcycles Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Racing Motorcycles Memory briefly shows you cards with motorcycle pictures before turning them over. Remember where each bike appeared, then reveal two matching cards at a time. Complete the board before the time limit. There are five levels, each giving you less time to recall the pairs and finish the search.

pages.title: Dunk Idle
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Dunk Idle is an incremental basketball game. Shoot baskets to earn coins, then buy better balls and hire a team to generate passive income. Clean dunks multiply the score from a hit, and leveling up multiplies your balance. Spend your earnings on upgrades that help each shot bring in more.

pages.title: Stickman Sniper 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Stickman Sniper 3D is a shooting game that puts you in the role of a lone sniper. Use the mouse to line up the rifle on the stickmen you need to take down. Check the target's position before firing and take the shot when you have a clear line.

pages.title: Mythology Gods Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Mythology Gods Hidden is a timed search game. Look for ten hidden stars in each mythological scene and click or tap them as you spot them. Keep an eye on the found counter to see how many are left. Search the quieter corners of the picture as well as the more detailed areas.

pages.title: Gap Fit
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Gap Fit is a sliding block puzzle about filling the gaps in a stack. Move a block sideways so it can fit into an opening. Check the pieces above and below before deciding where to slide it. Keep making space and scoring points before the blocks fill the screen.

pages.title: Speed Racer
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Speed Racer puts you on a track with other cars to avoid. Change lanes when you have a clear route and watch where the next vehicle is headed. Get through as much of the course as you can without a collision. The longer you stay on the track, the more score you can collect.

pages.title: Hunter Assassin
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Hunter Assassin is a stealth action game where you approach guards and take them out with a knife. Click or tap to move through the area, and time your approach to stay out of the other guards' view. Choose a route that lets you reach each target without getting caught.

pages.title: Piggy Run
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Piggy Run sends a piglet past poisonous mushrooms and other obstacles. Gather diamonds as you run and press Z to shoot at the mushrooms. Wings let the pig fly for a while, and pressing X in the air opens a parachute. Use those abilities to keep the piglet going as far as possible.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Garden Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Garden Party follows Hazel as she prepares to host her friends. Help send invitations, then choose a flower-print outfit and accessories for her. Once the guests arrive, join the group for the garden games and activities. The game takes you from the party preparations through the celebration itself.

pages.title: Modern Bus Parking Adventure Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Modern Bus Parking Adventure Game puts you behind the wheel of a bus for a series of driving and parking missions. Allow room for the long vehicle when turning and line it up carefully with the parking spot. Each mission gives you another route or space to maneuver the bus through.

pages.title: Miss Tuning Girls Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Miss Tuning Girls Slide is a sliding picture puzzle with three images and three modes. Move tiles around the board and use the details in the picture to see which pieces belong next to each other. Work through the layout until the image is restored, then try a different picture or mode.

pages.title: Touch Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Touch Ball is a reaction game about clicking a ball as it appears. Hit it quickly to add to your score and watch it change color with each click. Keep your attention on the play area so you can respond when the ball appears again. See how many hits you can get.

pages.title: Swing Copter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Swing Copter is a flight timing game played with clicks or taps. Guide the copter through narrow openings without crashing. Watch the gap ahead so you can adjust before reaching it. The goal is to stay in the air for as long as possible while making it through the tight spaces.

pages.title: Lumberjack Santa Claus
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Lumberjack Santa Claus lets you chop a tree as Santa or one of his elves. Work from either side of the trunk and switch when a branch is about to come down where you are standing. Keep cutting as long as you can without getting hit, adding to the pile of wood.

pages.title: zombie worms
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: In zombie worms, steer a worm beneath the ground and bring it up to attack the vehicles above. Press the left or right arrow key, or touch the corresponding side of the screen, to steer. Use the space underground to line up another attack and watch your health as the enemy fires back.

pages.title: Count The Animals
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Count The Animals gives you a picture to search for animals of the same species. Look at the animal the game asks for, then click every one you can find in the scene. Use the help button when one is hard to spot. You can ask for help only five times.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Fly
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Halloween Witch Fly takes a witch on a broom through a spooky forest. Guide her past ghosts, cats, bats and moons as they come into her path. Look for enough room to get through without touching anything. The aim is to stay in the air for as long as you can.

pages.title: Hyper Block Tetris Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Block Tetris Party is a falling-block puzzle. Guide the incoming shapes into open spaces to fill horizontal lines. Completed lines disappear and leave room for more blocks. Look at the gaps before placing each shape, and keep the pile low enough to fit the pieces that come after it.

pages.title: BMW X1 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: BMW X1 Puzzle gives you six pictures of the BMW X1 to assemble. Choose a picture and work with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Use the lines of the car and the surrounding details to place the pieces. Try a larger set when you want to tackle an image in smaller fragments.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Beach Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Beach Party takes Hazel to a gathering with her cousins. Choose a beach outfit and accessories before adding nail art. Then follow her to the party and join in the activities, dancing and food. The game moves from getting Hazel ready to spending time with everyone at the beach.

pages.title: Uphill Jeep Driving
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Uphill Jeep Driving puts you behind the wheel of a jeep on hilly routes. Use WASD to drive and press C to change the camera when you need another view. Pick up and drop off passengers as you work through the stages. Adjust your speed when the road changes slope.

pages.title: Oddbods Ice Cream Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Oddbods Ice Cream Fight is a target game where the Oddbods throw ice cream back at you. Aim at them before they duck, run aside or make their own throw. The characters get faster as you advance, and Fuse appears in boss levels. Watch for a clear opening before taking your shot.

pages.title: Dev vs Deadline
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Dev vs Deadline is a clicker about helping a developer finish a task before time runs out. Click the developer to work and dodge the distractions that fall into the way. Coffee helps the developer work faster. Keep making progress while watching for obstacles so the task gets done by the deadline.

pages.title: Fun Hockey
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fun Hockey offers air hockey in Football, Classic, Fun and Neon themes. Hit the puck toward the other goal and move to block the return. Grab bonuses when they appear on the field. You can play on your own or against a second player, and each theme adds its own feature to the match.

pages.title: Fruit Cartoon Puzzle
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Fruit Cartoon Puzzle gives you cartoon fruit pictures to rebuild from jigsaw pieces. Choose an easy, medium or hard layout and move the pieces into place. Start with a recognizable part of the picture, then look for pieces that continue its colors and outlines. Fit the whole image back together to finish.

pages.title: Endless Helix Jumper
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Endless Helix Jumper is an arcade game where you rotate a tower to let a bouncing ball drop through gaps. Watch for dangerous sections on the platforms and turn the helix before the ball comes down. The tower is generated anew, so look ahead for openings as you work toward a better score.

pages.title: Pen Run 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Pen Run 2 is a runner where a moving pen draws as it goes. Steer around obstacles and pick up ink pots to keep drawing. Look ahead for both hazards and the next supply of ink. Get the pen through more than thirty levels and finish the pictures along the way.

pages.title: EG Car Evolution
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Car Evolution is a merging game about building up a collection of cars. Combine matching cars to create an improved model. Keep space free for another pair as more vehicles come in. Earn coins as the collection grows and work through the merges to see which cars you can reach.

pages.title: Rolling Sky
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Rolling Sky sends a ball along an endless track suspended in the air. Hold to keep it moving and guide it around traps and gaps. Pick up diamonds where the route gives you room. Watch the next section of track before moving so you can stay on the road.

pages.title: Smileys
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Smileys is a timed reaction game about spotting frowning faces. Tap the frowns to change their expressions and leave the faces that are already smiling alone. Check each face before you tap, especially as more of them fill the board. Keep finding the right targets to improve your best score.

pages.title: Crazy Runner
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: Crazy Runner is an endless road game where you jump over cars, tires and bombs. Collect coins and food while watching what is coming toward you. Time each jump so you land clear of the next hazard. Run as far as possible and keep collecting pickups to build your score.

pages.title: Words Party
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Words Party is a word puzzle where pieces have to be arranged to form words. Look at the letters on each piece and try positions that make sense with the parts already in place. Reposition pieces as new words become clear. There are thirty-six layouts to work through.

pages.title: Cliff Diving
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Cliff Diving is a skill game where your score depends on how straight you enter the water. Launch from the cliff and time the dive so your body lines up for the landing. Earn money for better entries and use it to unlock more levels. Adjust your timing after a rough landing.

pages.title: World Cup 2018 Find the Difference
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: World Cup 2018 Find the Difference shows pairs of football-themed pictures with seven differences in each level. Compare the scenes and mark details that changed before the one-minute timer runs out. Search for both large changes and small details. There are ten levels, each with a new pair of pictures to compare.

pages.title: Kids Math
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Kids Math is a timed arithmetic game. Read each problem and choose the correct answer from three options. Work quickly while the timer runs, but check the calculation before you commit. Each correct answer adds to your score. Try another round to see how many problems you can solve in time.

pages.title: Flappy Shooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Flappy Shooter is an arcade game where you tap to jump and shoot through numbered blocks. Watch for a route you can clear before the blocks reach you. Collect power-ups to improve your shots, and break star blocks for extra power. Keep the shooter moving through the openings you make.

pages.title: Girls Easter Chocolate Eggs
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Easter Chocolate Eggs follows two girls getting their Easter egg stand ready in the park. Help them finish the remaining chocolate eggs for the event. Work through the decoration choices and see how each egg looks before moving to the next one. Complete the batch so the stand is ready.

pages.title: Döner Kebab : salade, tomates, oignons
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Döner Kebab : salade, tomates, oignons puts you behind a restaurant counter. Look at each customer's order and assemble a kebab with the requested ingredients. Serve quickly while checking what goes into each meal. The challenge is to get through as many orders as possible while keeping them accurate.

pages.title: Christmas Chain Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Christmas Chain Game is a holiday marble shooter inspired by Zuma. Fire into the moving chain to bring matching pieces together and clear them. Look ahead along the chain before choosing a target so you can use the available openings. Stop the chain and work through three progressively harder levels.

pages.title: Funny Golf!
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Funny Golf! takes you to courses on green fields, in a forest, in a cave and on a beach. Aim for the hole and judge how hard to hit the ball. The terrain changes between locations, so adapt your shots to each course. Try to finish in as few strokes as possible.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Rain Forest
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Rain Forest offers four rainforest photographs to assemble. Pick a photo and use features in the image to find where the pieces fit. Look for shapes or colors that continue across an edge, then build around the sections you have completed. Try another photograph once the full scene is together.

pages.title: Submaringer
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Submaringer sends a yellow submarine through underwater passages filled with obstacles. Guide it as far as you can while keeping your finger on the control. Watch for narrowing gaps and adjust the submarine's route before reaching them. Keep moving through the ocean and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Gear Madness
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Gear Madness is a racing game with ten tracks. Compete against other cars and try to win races to afford power-ups. Watch how your timing affects the car's speed as you work through the competitions. Use the upgrades you earn to prepare for faster rivals on the remaining tracks.

pages.title: Bowling Masters
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bowling Masters lets you choose a player and set the spin and power of each roll. Aim for strikes in standard frames, then adjust your delivery for moving pins or rounds with special targets such as bubbles. Use the mouse or keyboard to line up each attempt and keep your score climbing.

pages.title: Doodle History
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Doodle History gives you a jumble of lines that hides an architectural drawing. Adjust the view until the separate strokes line up into a recognizable image. Look for an outline to guide the final adjustments. The forty-eight puzzles cover structures from ancient, medieval and modern settings.

pages.title: Super Mahjong 3D
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Super Mahjong 3D is a tile-matching game played on stacks with more than one side to inspect. Look for matching tiles you can connect and clear, then check the newly exposed pieces for your next pair. Later stacks get trickier, so look at how each match will affect the tiles around it.

pages.title: Princesses Road Trip Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Road Trip Fun takes Elsa and Anna to the beach. Choose swimsuits and hairstyles for both sisters and bring them cocktails while they relax. Put together a beach look for each character before moving on to the photos. End the outing by helping them take selfies together.

pages.title: Pregnant Princess Tanning Solarium H5
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Pregnant Princess Tanning Solarium H5 lets you help a princess get ready for the solarium. Choose a light, medium or dark tan, then try gold or silver tattoos to finish the look. Compare how the designs appear against the shade you selected before settling on the princess's new style.
